Title: Azure Cosmos DB supports GROUP BY for queries for SQL (Core) API

Body.Content:
In response to user requests, Azure Cosmos DB now supports GROUP BY for queries for SQL (Core) API. Use GROUP BY to run queries that group your results according to the values of one or more specified properties. This feature is currently supported in Data Explorer, JavaScript SDK 3.4, and .NET SDK 3.3. Support for other SDKs will be available later in 2019.

Learn more about GROUP BY for queries
